name: Cafeteria
description: A cafe for patients and visitors: a food counter, a water machine, vending machines (more in a bigger cafe, up to 4) and tables of four. Patients who get something to eat and drink wait more patiently.
staffing: None: run by a catering contractor, who pays the hospital a share of the takings.

name: Vending point
description: A small alcove of vending machines (one for every 1.1 metres of back wall, up to 4) and a water machine, where waiting patients can get a snack and a drink.
staffing: None: the machines are stocked by the supplier, who pays the hospital a share of the takings.
